title: 2024 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] SIDESTORY: ZWILLINGSTÜRME IM HERBST OPEN
lines: 2024 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] LIMITED-TIME EVENTS
01 2024 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] SIDESTORY: ZWILLINGSTÜRME IM HERBST OPEN
DETAILS: Zwillingstürme im Herbst event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the Herzenfolgen, and redeeming from Event Store.
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
EVENT STAGES DURATION: Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
Phase 1 DURATION: April 30, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - May 21, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Open Stages: Zwillingstürme Anbeten
Phase 2 DURATION: May 7, 2024, 16:00 (UTC-7) - May 21, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Open Stages: Die Gnade Ist Ewig
Phase 3 DURATION: May 14, 2024, 16:00 (UTC-7) - May 21, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Open Stages: Die Macht Ist Grimm
Herzenfolgen
DETAILS: During the event, players can submit the suitable Inner Tune in "Herzenfolgen" to complete Routine Visitations and Covert Visitation for rewards.

MAIN REWARDS: Lessing's Folder (When first obtained, players will receive the event bonus Operator ★★★★★★: Lessing, after which you can use it to increase his potential), Investigation Resupply (provides random materials), etc.
Venesuhrenturm
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Venesuhrenturm] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: Ludwigs-Universität Lecture Hall Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Elite Materials, Die Klänge von den Erinnerungen, etc.
Herbstmondeskonzert
DETAILS: During the event, you can collect [Die Klänge von den Erinnerungen] by participating the event and use them to redeem items as rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: Ludwigs-Universität Lecture Hall Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, and more.
- During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
02 2024 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – BY MY WILL
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [By My Will], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Virtuosa [Limited] / Viviana
★★★★★★: Texas the Omertosa [Limited] / Specter the Unchained [Limited] / Nearl the Radiant Knight [Limited]
★★★★★: Bassline
NOTE: [By My Will] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] headhunting series. [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] is Limited Headhunting.

- After the [By My Will] banner ends, [Viviana] and [Bassline] will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after May 14, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7). Operator Virtuosa is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting. NOTE: Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 2024 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] SPECIAL LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: Log in during the event to claim reward on event page: Candleglow Sonata Headhunting Permit * 1

NOTE: Candleglow Sonata Headhunting Permit can only be used to performing a 10-roll in [By My Will] Limited Headhunting. Each account can only claim this reward once during the event. Stepping into Lupine Shadows Headhunting Permit expires at: May 14, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
04 2024 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] DAILY FREE ROLL IN [BY MY WILL] LIMITED HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: A free roll can be performed every day during the event in [By My Will] Limited Headhunting.
NOTE: Daily Free Roll will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day. Daily Free Roll can only be used once a day and will not accumulate.

Day 6: Transmuted Salt * 3, Orundum * 200
Day 7: Module Data Block * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 8: Pure Gold * 20, EPOQUE Collection - Gwiazdcytrony for Meteor

12 2024 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] IRON FIST CITY INDUSTRY COOPERATION FORUM

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Orundum by signing contracts every day, using different negotiation strategies can effectively influence the contract outcome. Possible contract outcomes are: Windfall Contract, Perfect Contract, Successful Contract, Guaranteed Contract.

Windfall Contract base value: 600 Orundum, Perfect Contract base value: 500 Orundum, Successful Contract base value: 400 Orundum, Guaranteed Contract base value: 300 Orundum. Contract values may vary based on industry circumstances.
Sign an agreement with all corporations from a single industry to be recognized as an industry partner and receive Special Development Funds worth 500 Orundum!
Using a negotiation strategy does not guarantee that you will be able to achieve a certain contract type. You can negotiate once per day. Negotiation window resets at 04:00 daily.
